dod_global.text: Every acceptance criterion has at least one automated test (unit, property or Playwright) that passes
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass with zero errors
The golden-spot suite passes 100% (applies from the story that creates the suite, E07-S14, onward)
Engine, bots, advice and statistics code imports no UI or browser-only code
Stories that touch the engine, bots or advice: a 10,000-hand playtest reports zero invariant violations (applies once the playtest runner exists, E01-S07, onward)

Stories that add or change a screen: Playwright test of the screen flow in Chromium and WebKit, and axe reports zero serious or critical violations (axe tooling is provisioned in the toolchain story E01-S01)
No new network requests beyond the app's own files
Strategy-content stories: text is original and every chart, range or golden spot carries its justification
CI workflow is green on the story's branch (applies once the CI story E01-S02 is done; E01-S01 instead passes the same checks locally)
Story documentation is written and published to Backlog.md
Stories that add a screen or dialog: once the offline service worker exists (E13-S07), the screen works with the network disabled

milestones.title: M1 Walking skeleton
milestones.description: Thinnest end-to-end path: toolchain + CI; seeded rules engine and headless playtest runner with invariant checks; 6-max preflop chart, equity calculator, basic postflop call/fold advice and grading; TAG bots built on the advice engine; Home -> Game Config -> a default 6-max $4/$8 cash table vs TAG bots in the browser; play a hand with legal actions, see the result; a basic Hand Review panel lists the user's decisions with recommendation and grade.

milestones.title: M2 MVP
milestones.description: MVP: every Must requirement except its sit-and-go-specific parts (REQ-002.6, the sit-and-go part of REQ-044.1, REQ-048.5 stay in M3 with sit-and-go), plus Rapid bot pace. Full casino fixed-limit rules (heads-up, cap, all-ins, side pots, showdown order, button movement) proven by a 1,000,000-hand invariant run; Game Config (2-10 players, stakes, game type, line-up presets and per-seat styles); buy-in/rebuy; pause/resume/leave; four bot styles inside their bands with reproducible decisions; complete advice engine (charts for 3 reference sizes, equity, range model, value and implied-odds rules, explanations, grading, golden spots, determinism); hint; full Hand Review; cash Session Report with style stats, healthy ranges and leaks; Statistics trends with filters and target lines; local persistence; Settings basics.

milestones.title: M3 Release 1
milestones.description: Release 1: everything else in baseline v1.9 (Should/Could and all sit-and-go play): sit-and-go structure, levels, results and its parts of Home, Report and Statistics; splash; Home snapshot and first-use message; random seat/button; Realistic pace and speed choice/change; remembered config; action log, table art, chips, animation, avatars, banter, session clock; opponent stats on hover; TAG strength proof; approximate/short-stack labels; style goal status; remaining Settings and reset; storage failure and migration; install/offline/updates; privacy/CSP; performance limits; accessibility audit; compatibility; CI deploy to GitHub Pages.

epics.title: Prove the game headlessly
epics.goal: A seeded, pure fixed-limit Hold'em rules engine plays complete hands headlessly and a playtest runner proves it, on a strict TypeScript toolchain with one-command checks and CI.

outcomes.text: Toolchain, npm check scripts and CI run on every push from the first story
Every hand follows casino fixed-limit rules: blinds, order of action, bet + 3 raises cap, all-ins, side pots, showdown, button movement
Seeded playtest runs report zero invariant violations over 1,000,000 hands and are reproducible

epics.title: Launch and set up a session
epics.goal: The user launches TLH Trainer, lands on Home and configures a session (game type, table size, stakes, line-up, speed) or resumes a paused one.

outcomes.text: Splash opens Home automatically; Home offers New game and Resume session when a paused session exists
Game Config offers 2-10 players, cash or sit-and-go, the six stakes and line-up presets, pre-filled from the last session
A session interrupted by going Home or closing the app resumes at the start of the next hand

epics.title: Play hands at the table
epics.goal: The user plays fixed-limit cash hands against bots on a clear, readable, responsive Table screen at Rapid or Realistic speed, with every hand recorded.

outcomes.text: The action bar offers only legal actions with exact amounts and the table shows every seat, the board, pots and the button
At Rapid speed 200 hands per hour are playable
Every completed hand is stored before the next is dealt

epics.title: Follow the action at a glance
epics.goal: The user follows every bet and pot at Rapid speed through an action log, chips in front of seats, speed-aware animation, bot avatars and banter, and a session clock showing their pace.

outcomes.text: An action log and chip stacks in front of seats show where the money went
Animations never slow practice: at most 250 ms at Rapid, none with reduce-motion
The header shows elapsed playing time and hands-per-hour pace

epics.title: Play a sit-and-go
epics.goal: The user plays a single-table sit-and-go with rising limits until they bust or win, and gets a finishing position.

outcomes.text: Levels rise every 10 hands on the published schedule and busted bots are not replaced
The sit-and-go ends with the user's finishing position out of the starting players

epics.title: Face distinct opponents
epics.goal: The user faces recognisable, reproducible bot styles (TAG, Calling station, Maniac, Rock) built on the advice engine, whose measured profiles and strength are proven headlessly.

outcomes.text: Each style's measured VPIP, PFR and aggression fall inside its target band in 100,000-hand playtests
A TAG bot beats five bots of any weaker style with 95% confidence
Replaying a hand reproduces every bot decision

epics.title: Get trustworthy advice
epics.goal: For any decision, the advice engine returns a deterministic, explainable recommendation with its numbers and grades the user's actual decision fairly, proven by a golden-spot suite.

outcomes.text: 100% of at least 200 golden spots pass in npm test
The same view and observed stats always produce the same recommendation, numbers, explanation and grade
Every recommendation explains its concept in at most three plain-English sentences with the numbers

epics.title: Ask for a hint
epics.goal: During their turn the user can ask what to do and immediately sees the recommendation, its numbers and the reason.

outcomes.text: A hint card with action, equity, required equity, explanation and basis appears within 1 s
Hinted decisions are marked so goal measures stay honest

epics.title: Review the hand just played
epics.goal: After each hand the user sees every decision they made graded Correct / Minor / Major with the recommended action, the numbers and the reason.

outcomes.text: The Hand Review panel opens within 1 s of a hand ending, listing each user decision with grade and numbers
Feedback never blocks practice: the next hand waits only while the panel is open

epics.title: Read the session report
epics.goal: When a session ends the user sees and keeps a play-style report: result, error rates, hint usage, style stats against healthy ranges and the top leaks.

outcomes.text: Every report value equals a value recomputed from the stored hand records
Up to three leaks are shown with evidence and a one-sentence fix
Home shows the latest session snapshot linking to its report

epics.title: Track progress over time
epics.goal: The user sees whether mistakes are shrinking, results improving and style moving into healthy ranges across sessions, measured against goals G-2..G-4.

outcomes.text: Major errors/100 and BB/100 trend charts with target and break-even lines
Style stats over the last 1,000 hands show how many of 5 are in range

epics.title: Tune the trainer
epics.goal: The user adjusts speed, review auto-open, style labels, deck colours and banter, and can reset all data, with changes taking effect immediately and persisting.

outcomes.text: Each setting persists across launches and takes visible effect
Reset all data deletes everything only after confirmation

epics.title: Rely on a private offline app
epics.goal: The user installs TLH Trainer to the Dock, uses it offline with no data leaving the machine, gets updates safely and never silently loses history.

outcomes.text: Installs from Chrome and Safari and works fully offline after first visit
No requests other than the app's own files; CSP restricts to own origin
Storage failures, migrations and unexpected errors never lose completed hands
